codes.use_case: Money, legal papers and facility bills
codes.moment: When early signs of decline appear and bills start slipping
codes.want: Know which plans and services will cover his care
codes.quote: needs help with bills, rotting food in fridge, more forgetfulness. I know we need to find out what health/medicaid plans he has so we know what services will be covered.

codes.use_case: Money, legal papers and facility bills
codes.moment: While selling the parent's house and applying for Medicaid at once
codes.want: Less pressure to sign documents before understanding them
codes.quote: the financial dept where she is a resident had me signing documents to apply for medicaid right now, this minute

codes.use_case: Exhaustion, guilt and no life of their own
codes.moment: After weeks of paperwork, house sale setbacks and a friend's death
codes.want: A few days away to rest and shut it out
codes.quote: I just want to go away for a few days even by myself and chill and shut some of this out.

codes.moment: Every night, when heavy urine soaks the diaper and bed by morning
codes.want: Keep her and the bed dry overnight without waking up
codes.quote: I use heavy absorbent diapers with an ultimate overnight pad. By 7 am she’s soaked and so is her bed.

codes.use_case: Exhaustion, guilt and no life of their own
codes.moment: While giving daily care to a parent who was emotionally distant
codes.want: To stop feeling resentful and not be judged
codes.quote: Right now I’m resentful and really don’t understand why I can’t get over it and just be there for her the way a daughter should be.

codes.moment: When a stressor sets off repeated requests, worries and nagging
codes.quote: She’s constantly asking for the same things and states the same worries.

codes.use_case: Money, legal papers and facility bills
codes.moment: After a sudden move-in, while Medicaid waits on a co-POA problem
codes.want: Get the legal authority and Medicaid application sorted
codes.quote: It's been a month now and we still havent applied for Medicaid. We are waiting to speak to an attorney

codes.use_case: Exhaustion, guilt and no life of their own
codes.moment: After a parent-in-law moves in suddenly following hospital discharge
codes.want: Know what their responsibility is and regain some control
codes.quote:
I don't even know if I want to be a caregiver or have the ability to be. 
Just feels like I'm grasping at some kind of control.

codes.use_case: Relatives don't help, or block each other
codes.moment: When siblings refuse help even after being begged
codes.want: Siblings who share the care
codes.quote: When I broke down and begged them to help me, younger sister told me, "We all make our choices."

codes.use_case: Exhaustion, guilt and no life of their own
codes.moment: After years of caregiving since the parent's stroke
codes.want: The courage to stop caregiving
codes.quote: I am so tired of dealing with this for over 4 years since Mom's stroke. I wish I had the courage to stop caregiving

codes.moment: At night when he sundowns badly and becomes aggressive
codes.quote: She is living with her grandpa, who has dementia and is sundowning VERY badly and becoming aggressive.

codes.moment: At night, to stop him hurting himself or leaving
codes.want: Him in a place with 24-hour care she can afford
codes.quote: She is forced to stay awake all night preventing him from hurting himself, hurting her cat, and leaving the house.

codes.use_case: Relatives don't help, or block each other
codes.moment: When the relative holding POA refuses to act or answer
codes.want: The POA holder to take responsibility for care decisions
codes.quote: grandpa's POA is her uncle but he wants nothing to do with this situation and has practically abandoned her in this process

codes.use_case: Getting answers from doctors and hospitals
codes.moment: After the doctor's office promises a callback and goes silent
codes.want: The doctor's office to call back with advice
codes.quote: they said they would call back to help her but they have also gone missing and will no longer answer the phone

codes.use_case: Exhaustion, guilt and no life of their own
codes.moment: While working full time and staying up all night watching him
codes.quote: My friend is at a loss, we are in our early 20s and we both no idea what to do and this is ruining her life

codes.moment: Every evening when sundowning brings hallucinations and repeated phrases
codes.want: Something that calms the episodes when reassurance and distraction fail
codes.quote: Lately, she has been suffering severely in the evenings with sundowning and hallucinations.

codes.moment: After the parent gets lost once on a daily walk alone
codes.want: Know if she can be left alone, and what risk is acceptable
codes.quote: Can she no longer be left alone? Do I hire a caregiver? For how many hours per day? Is it really "that time"?

codes.use_case: Money, legal papers and facility bills
codes.moment: While care costs drain both parents' savings toward running out
codes.want: Know the Medicaid process and when to get a lawyer
codes.quote: Both of these cost them individually about $5,000 - $7,000 per beyond their pension and Social Security income so the difference is coming out of their savings.

codes.use_case: Choosing and arranging a place for them
codes.moment: While savings run down toward a Medicaid facility move
codes.want: Know when to start researching facilities and keep family input
codes.quote: how far in advance did you start researching facilities? Or does the family not really have any input once Medicaid is paying?

codes.use_case: Choosing and arranging a place for them
codes.moment: After a confused night changes which level of care is needed
codes.want: Respect her choice while still getting the move decided
codes.quote: I am struggling in giving her the respect of seeing her future home, and balancing that with getting the decisions made to move her

codes.moment: When the parent tours a facility but says she is fine
codes.quote: But said there's no reason to move her, because she's doing just fine.

codes.use_case: Relatives don't help, or block each other
codes.moment: While the far-away sibling only comments instead of helping
codes.quote: I have an older brother who lives 3 hours away and is present only enough to tell me "this is so difficult, but what can we do?"

codes.moment: When it is time to take car keys and credit card
codes.want: Help the other parent feel less guilty and act
codes.quote: Mom is feeling guilty about wanting to take dad's car keys and credit card away. She has been venting to me about this for awhile.

codes.moment: When the parent backs out a week before the move
codes.want: The parent to move somewhere safe
codes.quote: My Mom had agreed to move into AL and then turned around yesterday (about a week before it was time to move) and says 100% no way.

codes.use_case: Relatives don't help, or block each other
codes.moment: When a sibling sides with the parent staying home
codes.want: The sibling to agree on how bad things really are
codes.quote: my sister says if she wants to stay, she should stay.

codes.use_case: Exhaustion, guilt and no life of their own
codes.moment: While caring for the parent instead of their own child's school years
codes.want: Help managing the grief, overwhelm and hopelessness
codes.quote: I'm supposed to be enjoying my one and only child's high school years and instead all I do is take care of my Mom and feel like dying.

codes.moment: When the caregiver is not there to make meals
codes.quote: Most days if I'm not there, she's eating cookies and chips and nothing else.

codes.use_case: Choosing and arranging a place for them
codes.moment: When the facility will not accept the DPOA's signature
codes.want: Be able to sign the move-in papers as DPOA
codes.quote: I do have the DPOA but the community insists on having Mom sign it.

codes.moment: When seasons change and the parent in assisted living needs warmer clothes
codes.want: Let her still choose her own clothes
codes.quote: I tried buying her some warmer clothes and bringing them to her but I saw that she was frustrated because some fit, others did not

codes.use_case: Exhaustion, guilt and no life of their own
codes.moment: After the parent moves into a facility she does not want
codes.want: Know whether they are doing too much or the wrong thing
codes.quote: I am now questioning just about everything I do for my Mom.

codes.moment: During visits when the parent in late stage barely speaks
codes.want: Know how to connect with her at this stage
codes.quote: She rarely speaks during visits. Her speech is mostly sounds

codes.moment: During the first night after moving into memory care
codes.want: It not to happen again
codes.quote: Then at about 10pm last night, he had a psychotic episode - was verbally abusive and physically violent.

codes.moment: After the other parent dies and she keeps asking for him
codes.want: A way to answer that does not cause a meltdown
codes.quote: At first we were telling her that he died but that would cause a meltdown every time and it was heartbreaking.

codes.moment: While caring for partner and roommate and starting a job
codes.want: Feel supported and less tired
codes.quote: I just feel so angry and tired and unsupported all the time. I don’t have many friends and I struggle with making them.

codes.moment: After the partner gets a catheter and can barely move
codes.quote: I am constantly tired because, he just got a catheter. He hasn’t been able to move much for about two months

codes.moment: Every evening after the aide visits while the caregiver is at work
codes.want: Know how the visit actually went without guilty double-checking
codes.quote: Most days the aide comes while I am at work, and by evening I realize I honestly do not know how the visit went.

codes.moment: After the spouse dies, when grief returns months later
codes.want: To move through grief without losing her memories
codes.quote: The journey since has been difficult, painful, sleepless, guilt ridden, an abundance of tears at unexpected moments, lonely, oh so lonely

codes.use_case: Safety when they are alone or out
codes.moment: When out in public and he must use a restroom alone
codes.quote: there’s no family restroom and my DH has to go into the men’s room by himself

codes.moment: When thinking of leaving him with someone else for a few hours
codes.want: A helper patient enough to meet his specific needs
codes.quote: It’s hard for me to leave him in someone else’s care even for a few hours because I know his specific needs

codes.moment: When he needs help dressing or rising and her body aches
codes.quote: he needs help getting up and my knees or back make me slow to stand and walk or bend down to help put on

codes.moment: When the partner gets a once-easy household task wrong
codes.want: Know whether to point out mistakes without upsetting her
codes.quote: I am wondering whether this is something not to bother pointing out, as this tends to provoke a range of emotions, from irritation to anger.

codes.moment: When thinking about placing the spouse while he still knows her
codes.want: To stop feeling like an awful person for wanting it
codes.quote: When I think about placing my DH into some level of care facility these thoughts come to mind:

codes.moment: When the specialist asks for daily blood pressure readings at home
codes.want: A small device that sends readings to all her doctors
codes.quote: her cardiologist wants her to use a BP monitor for daily or twice daily reads since her BPs are trending higher. Their office recommended "any home device."

codes.moment: When the caregiver needs someone to stay so they can leave
codes.want: Bring in a companion without upsetting her
codes.quote: how to you get someone in to spend time with her so I can leave her alone?? The fact that I would suggest it would upset her

codes.use_case: Safety when they are alone or out
codes.moment: While she helps cook and does something unsafe in the kitchen
codes.quote: Last night she tried to do something while helping to cook dinner that was a clear fire hazard

codes.moment: After she shops online and buys far more than she meant
codes.quote: She bought "one or two things" on TEMU the other day...12 things totaling over $200.

codes.moment: After a confusing appointment when she gets stuck on a worry
codes.quote: it took a few days of answering those questions/concerns over and over before she stopped asking about it.

codes.moment: While adjusting to a new early-onset diagnosis with three kids
codes.want: Somewhere to vent and be heard
codes.quote: I don't really have anywhere else to vent. Thank you for listening.

codes.moment: After a recent diagnosis, while working full time with no family nearby
codes.quote: it is non stop on my side and it drains me to know end.  I work full time and it is just me.  No family around this area.

codes.moment: After the paid caregiver stops showing up without notice
codes.want: The same trusted caregiver every time, found through people they know
codes.quote: one day didn’t show up with no phone call or anything to alert us to her quitting. Then wouldn’t return my call.

codes.moment: When anxiety and outbursts grow and non-drug methods stop working
codes.want: Get her anxiety and agitation under control
codes.quote: Her anxiety/ agitation/ emotional outbursts and general "altered states" are recently getting more pronounced.

codes.moment: When a new calming medicine is about to be prescribed
codes.want: Ways to get her to take the medicine
codes.quote: Getting the meds into her will likely be yet another new hurdle.

codes.moment: When the caregiver needs own appointments or a break
codes.want: Time away for own doctor visits and a mental health break
codes.quote: I'm finding it really difficult to leave my DW to get a haircut, attend to car repairs/ maintenance, go to my own dr's & dentists appts.

codes.use_case: Safety when they are alone or out
codes.moment: After the caregiver leaves the house for a few minutes
codes.quote: I'm still worried about her safety when I'm away as well as her frantic phone calls minutes after I leave

codes.use_case: Safety when they are alone or out
codes.moment: When out somewhere and he goes into a public restroom alone
codes.quote: lately he gets confused when he goes into the men’s room when we’re out somewhere. There are too many doors

codes.moment: Every day when he needs help dressing and walking
codes.quote: He needs help dressing and a hand to hold when walking because he loses his balance sometimes

codes.moment: When considering leaving him with another helper for a few hours
codes.want: A helper who is patient and calm with him
codes.quote: whoever helps him if I’m not around needs to be patient and not a bit irritated or nervous

codes.moment: During a sudden blood pressure swing when he describes leaving his body
codes.want: Know if others have seen this happen
codes.quote: he said he was outside his body standing in corner looking into a painting

codes.moment: After the admissions nurse's exam moves care into hospice
codes.quote: After extensive visit and exam with admissions nurse, we went into hospice mode.

codes.moment: When the neurologist suggests a hospice evaluation after recent changes
codes.want: Know what to expect and how hospice differs from palliative care
codes.quote: Recently, she has had some changes that has led her neurologist to suggesting we get a hospice evaluation.

codes.moment: When asking about medicines or giving daily reminders
codes.want: Check on her without causing offense
codes.quote: She is determined to stay independent and takes offense to any questions or reminders about medications and other normal daily questions or reminders.

codes.moment: During a rough talk when she says he is a bad caregiver
codes.want: Find reactions that calm things between them
codes.quote: We just cannot get along, and I can’t find reactions or lack of reactions that work with her.
